_notes: TEST DRAFT for Structure Controller, CurseForge mod 1470304. This is not an SR's Structure Limits plugin configuration.
The intended item-specific limit is one Seed Farm Ultimate Tek Plot per tribe per map.
MaxStructuresPerTribe=2000000000 is a finite high-cap workaround for a zero-limit bug found by static inspection of mod file 7842511. It is not literal unlimited, and it has not been tested in-game.
Other custom structure settings are empty; the connected-structure cap and optional limit UI/command are disabled.
The inspected mod contacts an external verification service before applying settings. Whether a creator-issued license is required remains unconfirmed. No credentials are included.
Host this file at a public raw HTTPS URL. In GameUserSettings.ini use [StructureController] JsonSource= followed by that URL without the https:// prefix.

Test ordinary building, the first and second Ultimate Tek Plot in the same tribe, a first plot in another tribe, and restart persistence before using on a live map. Existing excess plots are not automatically removed by the inspected placement check.
